mapper.insert: INSERT INTO idempotency_record (operator_id, operation_type, idempotency_key, request_hash, status, resource_type, resource_id, response_code, failure_message, locked_until, created_at, updated_at, expires_at) VALUES (#{operatorId}, #{operationType}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{requestHash}, #{status}, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, #{lockedUntil}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{expiresAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, operator_id, operation_type, idempotency_key, request_hash, status, resource_type, resource_id, response_code, failure_message, locked_until, created_at, updated_at, expires_at FROM idempotency_record WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
